description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of Difficulty” shows how items in the referenced dataset are divided across difficulty levels, with a total of five slices. The slices are labeled with percentages on or near the wedges: Medium is shown in pink at about 51.8%, Hard is blue at about 25.7%, Easy is light green at about 11.2%, Very hard is light orange at about 6.5%, and Very easy is light purple at roughly 4.7% (not explicitly labeled on the wedge but implied by the remaining share). A legend in the upper-left labeled “Difficulty” lists the same categories with counts (Medium 725,892; Hard 360,137; Easy 157,053; Very hard 91,576; Very easy 65,332). No slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the wedges appear arranged roughly from the largest (Medium) through smaller categories around the circle.
